title: AE Spotlight
description: Person-led ad that introduces one Account Executive (or any team member) to local dental practices by first name, with three benefits and a demo CTA.
useWhen: A person is the message: an AE, a speaker or a team member introduced by first name, with a demo or meeting CTA.
notWhen: The ad sells a product claim, or announces an event booth.
guidance: ae-first-name: first name followed by a period ("Sarah."). "Meet" is fixed and scales with the name. If only the full name is given, the first name is derived from it.
ae-name and ae-title share the name plate. Leave either out when unknown; the plate closes up, and disappears when both are missing.
ae-location: city and state ("Austin, TX"), set uppercase by the design. Leave it out when unknown and the pill disappears.

ae: the person's real photo as a cutout (transparent PNG). Without a photo the no-photo version is used automatically (the name plate becomes the centre of the blue panel). Never use another person's photo or generate one.
